meta.name: antigravity-quota
meta.description: Check Antigravity account quotas for Claude and Gemini models. Shows remaining quota and reset times with ban detection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询AI模型账户配额与剩余用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要查看Claude或Gemini的API配额和重置时间。
copy.tagline_en: Check AI model account quotas and remaining usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to check Claude or Gemini API quotas and reset times.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以检查 Antigravity 账户中 Claude 和 Gemini 模型的配额使用情况，显示剩余配额、重置时间，并检测账户是否被封禁。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看 Antigravity 账户配额或询问 Claude/Gemini 模型剩余使用量时触发。

say.text: 检查我的 Antigravity 账户配额。
say.note: 显示所有账户的配额摘要。

say.text: Claude Opus 还剩多少配额？
say.note: 显示 Claude 模型的剩余百分比和重置时间。

say.text: Gemini Flash 的配额什么时候重置？
say.note: 显示 Gemini Flash 的配额重置时间。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can check quota usage for Antigravity accounts, showing remaining quota, reset times, and ban detection for Claude and Gemini models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to check Antigravity account quotas or inquire about remaining usage for Claude/Gemini models.

say_en.note: Shows quota summary for all accounts.

say_en.text: How much quota is left for Claude Opus?
say_en.note: Shows remaining percentage and reset time for Claude models.

say_en.text: When does Gemini Flash quota reset?
say_en.note: Shows reset time for Gemini Flash.
